newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norsk Hydro completes N. Sea appraisal well.
newsitem.headline: Norsk Hydro completes N. Sea appraisal well.

text.p: Norsk Hydro ASA, as operator of exploration licence 090, has completed drilling of appraisal well 35/11-9 in the North Sea, where oil and gas was discovered in 1996, the Norwegian Oil Directorate said on Tuesday.
The well, drilled to a depth of 2,801 metres below sea level, has now been permanently plugged and abandoned. No results for the well were given.
Partners in licence 090 are Norsk Hydro with 25 percent, Mobil Corp with 25 percent and Den norske stats oljeselskap AS with 50 percent.
